Nina: Quick roundup from the postmortem - concise owners + firm ETAs for DR failover follow-ups. Reply exactly: owner: action — ETA (date) and one-line risk if any.

Omar: Omar: owner: multi-region routing reconciler — action: implement deploy-time route diff + auto-heal flag — ETA: 2026-04-11 — Risk: needs platform CI access in each region.

Leah: Leah: owner: incremental snapshot verification — action: add post-snapshot chain check + base-id metadata — ETA: 2026-04-07 — Risk: storage API change may require coordination.

Ben: Ben: owner: restore runbook & partial-restore drills — action: document single-AZ vs full-region restores, timings & rollback steps — ETA: 2026-04-05 — Risk: requires reserved staging infra for dry-run.

Nina: Noted — two recurring patterns we want to prevent: route table drift during autoscale and unverified incremental chains causing restore delays.

Omar: I'll also add a smoke test that simulates burst scale and validates route reconciliation. ETA: 2026-04-13.

Leah: I'll PR the snapshot verifier and link to the playbook; will add a short script to validate incremental integrity before promoting snapshots.

Ben: OpsBot: can you tentatively schedule a 3h game day window for the dry-run in early Apr?

OpsBot: OpsBot: Created calendar event "DR failover dry-run (staging)" on 2026-04-06 09:00-12:00 UTC. Playbook stub: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/dr-dry-run. Invitees: oncall/platform/storage/network.

InfraBot: InfraBot: ticket INF-842 created to track CI runner availability in target regions.

Nina: Great. Owners, update the postmortem tracker with ticket/PR links and a one-line blocker note by EOD today. We'll do a 15-min sync Mon 14:00 UTC to confirm. :white_check_mark:
